title: 404 Error Page
content: Build friendly 404 error page. Centered content: illustration or creative visual (lost astronaut, broken robot, etc.). Headline: "Page Not Found" or creative alternative. Helpful message: explain what happened. Navigation options: "Go Home" primary button, "Go Back" secondary, search input. Suggested pages: popular or recent pages. Report issue link. Consistent with site branding.

variants.simple: Create 404 error page with illustration and navigation options.
variants.detailed: Build friendly 404 error page. Centered content: illustration or creative visual (lost astronaut, broken robot, etc.). Headline: "Page Not Found" or creative alternative. Helpful message: explain what happened. Navigation options: "Go Home" primary button, "Go Back" secondary, search input. Suggested pages: popular or recent pages. Report issue link. Consistent with site branding.
variants.advanced: Build engaging and helpful 404 error page. Layout: min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center px-4, centered content. Illustration section: large creative visual (w-96 h-auto), options include: lost astronaut floating, broken robot, confused dog, empty box, 404 numbers styled creatively. Can use Lottie animation for movement. Can be SVG illustration or image. Headline: text-3xl md:text-4xl font-bold mt-8, "Oops! Page Not Found" or creative: "Looks like you are lost in space", "This page took a vacation", "404: Reality not found". Message: text-gray-600 text-lg max-w-md text-center mt-4, "The page you are looking for might have been moved, deleted, or never existed." Action buttons: flex gap-4 mt-8 justify-center. "Go Home" primary button (Home icon + text), "Go Back" secondary button (ArrowLeft icon + text, uses history.back()). Search section: "Or try searching:" text, search input with button, searches site content. Suggested pages: mt-12, "You might be looking for:" heading, grid or list of 4-6 popular/helpful pages with icons and brief descriptions (Home, Products, Pricing, Contact, Help Center, Blog). Report issue: text-sm text-gray-500 mt-8, "Think this is a mistake? Let us know." with link to report. Branding: maintain site header/navigation if applicable, or simplified logo-only header. Footer: optional minimal footer or none. Background: can add subtle pattern, gradient, or particle animation for visual interest. Console Easter egg: optional console.log with ASCII art or funny message for developers. Auto-redirect: optionally suggest redirect if close URL match found. Status code: ensure server returns proper 404 status. Analytics: track 404 hits with referring URL for debugging. Mobile: responsive illustration size, stack buttons vertically. Accessibility: proper heading, alt text on illustration, all links/buttons accessible.
